description: The heart of PortfolioPilot. One immutable record per 'Analyze Opportunity' action. It is an EVENT/SNAPSHOT: once written it is never edited, so the user can revisit an old analysis and see exactly what the AI concluded at that time, even if their profile changed since.

userId.description: REFERENCE -> users._id. Owner. Also the admin 'linked user' column in the Job Analyses Log.

job.description: EMBEDDED SNAPSHOT of the pasted posting. Deliberately duplicated rather than referenced: a job posting has no independent lifecycle in this product and the raw text must remain frozen for audit/re-scoring.

normalizedTitle.description: DERIVED lowercase title. Powers the 'most analysed job roles' admin chart without a $toLower over the whole collection.

description.description: Raw pasted JD. Capped at 30k chars: well under the 16MB document limit and far beyond any real posting.

analysis.description: Output of generateMatch(jobDescription, userProfile). All four scores are stored as SEPARATE numeric fields (not a nested map) so each can be indexed, averaged and filtered independently.

matchScore.description: Overall weighted score shown in the big progress ring.

strongSkills.description: Display names the user HAS and the job WANTS (green tags).

strongSkillsNormalized.description: DERIVED. Aggregation-safe form for 'most requested skills'.

skillGaps.description: Display names the job WANTS but the user LACKS (amber/red tags).

skillGapsNormalized.description: DERIVED. THE field the admin 'Top skill gaps' bar chart unwinds. Without it the chart would count 'React', 'React.js' and 'ReactJS' as three different gaps.

extractedRequirements.description: Requirement lines parsed out of the JD, each marked met/unmet. Backs the Requirements Match sub-score.

engine.description: Which scorer produced this record, e.g. 'mock-v1', 'keyword-v2', 'embeddings-v1'. Essential for comparing scores after an algorithm change.

recommendedProjects.description: REFERENCES, never copies. Storing the full project document here would duplicate large text/image data across every analysis and go stale the moment the user edits the project.

titleSnapshot.description: Only the title is snapshotted, so a soft-deleted project still renders as readable history.

reason.description: Human-readable justification shown on the Match Analysis chips.

tailoredSummary.description: Auto-written professional summary aimed at this specific role. Copied into the generated resume.

resumeId.description: REFERENCE -> resumes._id. Denormalised back-pointer so /match-analysis can show 'Resume already generated' without a second query. resumes.jobAnalysisId remains the authoritative link.

portfolioId.description: REFERENCE -> portfolios._id for the job-specific adapted portfolio, if one was generated.

createdAt.description: Analyses are immutable, so there is intentionally no updatedAt.
